strongest_objection: The item the author chose as the map's consequential adjacency and neighbor-test anchor, Gap between the deed and the book, states the wrong mechanism. Its headline, that the recording act 'decides ownership by the order of entries', is the pure race statute's shape only; under a notice statute the later buyer who bought without notice of the first deed wins even if she never records, and the first buyer's stamp works as a warning that charges later buyers with notice rather than as a rank. The item then names endings for two different parties' powers in one breath, since 'a later entry in the gap' ends the unrecorded first buyer's deed while 'proof that the entrant knew' ends the recorded second buyer's stamp, and it assigns knowledge-reading to the notice statute alone when race-notice reads the mind too. The gate's own separating case (same race, same proof, opposite result) is correct and survives, which is why this is a repair and not a cut, but the text the reader meets contradicts the test the author passed. Two edges carry the next heaviest faults. Made before it mattered → Key that lights its own fuse rests on the business-records rule for a record the defendant uses against its author, but a party's own statement is admissible against her whatever its regularity, so the discipline that dates the fuse and the discipline that makes the key are not the same discipline; the true shape is asymmetric and sharper (an ad hoc note dates the fuse without giving a key), and the relation is a tradeoff, not the incompatibility the form inference claims. Held unfired → Bounty for the first to file says a colleague's filing 'also ends her lever', but a qui tam complaint is filed under seal and the employer learns nothing, so the bounty dies silently while the lever goes on working, which is a stronger incompatibility than the label draws. Everything else survived real pressure: the fork at Bearer's cargo, the Fence and Rent loop (whose return edge is settled doctrine, not speculation), the pen-swap hinge, and the new member Right without the paper are the map's genuine discoveries, and no item restates witness-architectures.

items.item: Bearer's cargo: possession of the trace is the whole power, as a negotiable bill of lading obliges the carrier to deliver the goods to whoever surrenders an original and to nobody else, so the cargo belongs at the discharge port to the hand that holds the paper and not to the party who paid for it, and a ship that arrives before its documents sits at anchor or discharges against a bank's letter of indemnity; the carrier is the original bill, of which a set of three is usually issued and any one accomplishes the rest; the rule is the carrier's duty to deliver only against an original, which makes presentment the only recognition the trace needs; what ends the power is delivery, which spends the paper, or a bill issued straight to a named consignee, under which possession proves nothing; not status-conversions' Notarized standing, a bearer copy of an entry kept in someone else's ledger, since here no ledger stands behind the paper and the paper is the entry.
items.why: Passes the type: delivery is unavailable to anyone who cannot surrender an original, the carrier's duty is the rule, and delivery spends the paper. It does not fall into the map's own exclusion for traces that constitute their fact, since the goods and their shipment stand without the bill and only the right to delivery hangs on it. The only soft spot is the straight-bill clause, noted under modality.

items.item: Order that must be in the room: a signed trace lets a clinician withhold treatment the protocol would otherwise compel, but only where the paper is physically present at the moment, as a paramedic at a house where the portable medical order is not on the refrigerator door resuscitates whatever the family says was signed at the clinic; the carrier is the form and its location, which is why the protocols tell patients where to keep it; the rule is an emergency protocol that reads the form and not the account of it, since the crew cannot verify a story in the minutes it has; what ends the power is the patient's revocation, which may be spoken at any moment, or the form's absence from the room, so possession by the signer, recognition by the protocol, and activation at the bedside are three separate conditions and the last is the one that fails; not deal-deaths' Missing witness, where a form refuses a belief and the trade dies, since here nobody doubts the fact and the act happens the wrong way.
items.why: Distinct from Bearer's cargo in the right way: the power turns on where the paper is, not whose hand holds it, and the item is the map's clearest demonstration that possession, recognition, and activation are three conditions. The protocol reading is accurate for the common out-of-hospital shape.

items.item: Squawk that grounds: a trace a party can write converts her refusal into a state of the machine that nobody above her can override, as a pilot's entry of a discrepancy in the aircraft's maintenance log makes the aircraft unairworthy until a licensed mechanic signs it off or defers it under the minimum equipment list, so the schedule pressure that could argue with a captain cannot argue with a logbook; the carrier is the logbook, which travels with the aircraft; the rule is the airworthiness regulation, which reads open entries and not opinions; what ends the power is the sign-off or the deferral, and it begins with the pen, so the moment of activation is the moment of making, and the same shape appears where a failing check blocks a merge that a manager cannot force; not a refusal, which any pilot may attempt and any operator may pressure, since the mechanism is the trace that takes the refusal out of the pilot's hands and puts it in the aircraft's.
items.why: The mechanism is right and the discriminator against a bare refusal is the map's fence in miniature. The software aside overclaims: branch protection can be bypassed by an administrator, so 'cannot force' is false as written; the honest version is that forcing it takes the admin key and leaves an entry, which is the same shape as the mechanic's sign-off. Also misfiled on the itinerary; see seriation.
items.repair: Squawk that grounds: a trace a party can write converts her refusal into a state of the machine that nobody above her can override, as a pilot's entry of a discrepancy in the aircraft's maintenance log makes the aircraft unairworthy until a licensed mechanic signs it off or defers it under the minimum equipment list, so the schedule pressure that could argue with a captain cannot argue with a logbook; the carrier is the logbook, which travels with the aircraft; the rule is the airworthiness regulation, which reads open entries and not opinions; what ends the power is the sign-off or the deferral, and it begins with the pen, so the moment of activation is the moment of making, and the same shape appears where a failing check blocks a merge that a manager can force only by taking the admin key, which leaves an entry of its own; not a refusal, which any pilot may attempt and any operator may pressure, since the mechanism is the trace that takes the refusal out of the pilot's hands and puts it in the aircraft's.

items.item: Stamp beats sight: priority goes to the party whose trace the recognized office made, not to the party who first knew, as under first-to-file patent law an earlier independent inventor's dated notebook counts for nothing against a later inventor's earlier filing unless the filer took the invention from her, and a comet carries the names of those who reported it promptly and not of whoever saw it first; the carrier is the office's timestamp; the rule is a registry that reads only its own entries, so the notebook, the lab witness, and the sealed envelope are traces with no reader; what ends the power is the term, or a publication by anyone before the filing, which is the one outside trace the office does read and which destroys the novelty the stamp certified, so the inventor who announces before she files has made the trace that ends her own power, in most jurisdictions at once and in the United States after a year; not who-can-be-bound's Portable file, a registry that lets a stranger be bound, since here the registry ranks two claimants who never dealt with each other by the order in which they reached it.
items.why: Accurate for first-to-file with the derivation carve-out, and the comet case is a true second registry. The one-year clause is correct only for the inventor's own disclosure, and the text says exactly that. Keep.

items.item: Gap between the deed and the book: as between two buyers of the same land from the same seller, the recording act decides ownership by the order of entries in the public index rather than by the dates on the deeds, so the trace that matters is the recorder's stamp and the days between signing and recording are an open window in which a second deed can be cut and filed ahead; the carrier is the county index; the rule is the recording statute, and its three forms differ on whether the winner's knowledge counts, since a pure race statute reads only the index, a notice statute lets the earlier buyer defeat a later one who knew of her, and a race-notice statute demands both ignorance and the earlier entry; what ends the power is a later entry in the gap, or, under a notice statute, proof that the entrant knew; not Stamp beats sight, which ranks strangers and reads nothing outside the office, since here the two claims came through one seller and two of the three rules read the winner's mind; not who-can-be-bound's Seizable title, which says a registry makes property reachable, since this says the order of entries ranks the reachers.
items.why: The item's headline mechanism, 'ownership by the order of entries', is the race statute's shape only. Under a notice statute the later buyer who bought without notice wins even if she never records; the first buyer's stamp works as a warning that charges later buyers with notice, not as a rank. The item also names endings for two different parties' powers: 'a later entry in the gap' ends the unrecorded first buyer's deed, while 'proof that the entrant knew' ends the recorded second buyer's stamp, and race-notice reads knowledge too, not only notice. The author's own separating case in the gate is correct and survives; the item text contradicts it. Repaired to name the party, say what the index does under each form, and give one party's endings.
items.repair: Gap between the deed and the book: as between two buyers of the same land from the same seller, the recording act reads the public index and not the dates on the deeds, so the days between signing and recording are an open window in which a second deed can be cut and filed ahead of the first; the carrier is the county index; the rule is the recording statute, and its three forms differ on what the index does, since a pure race statute ranks the entries and reads nothing else, a notice statute uses the first buyer's entry only as a warning, so that a later buyer who bought without notice of her wins even if she never records, and a race-notice statute demands both the earlier entry and ignorance; the power is the later buyer's, to keep land she bought second, and what ends it is the first buyer's entry landing first, before the second purchase under a notice statute and before the second recording under the other two, or, under the two statutes that read the mind, proof that she knew of the unrecorded deed; not Stamp beats sight, which ranks strangers and reads nothing outside the office, since here the two claims came through one seller and two of the three rules read the winner's mind; not who-can-be-bound's Seizable title, which says a registry makes property reachable, since this says the index decides which of two reachers keeps it.

items.item: Made before it mattered: a record is recognized only if it was made when nobody needed it, as the business-records exception admits the shift log kept at or near the time in the regular course and excludes the accident report written once litigation was in view, so the same fact in the same hand is evidence or nothing according to the date and motive of its writing; the carrier is the routine itself, the maintenance log, the ledger, the ticket system, whose regularity is what the court trusts; the rule is the hearsay exception's requirement of regular course and contemporaneity, with its exclusion for records prepared for the dispute; what ends the power is the day the record-keeping becomes preparation, often the day the lawyer arrives, so a party that starts keeping better records when the dispute starts has made traces it cannot use, and the operator's only move is to have kept them before; not witness-architectures' Half kept back, where the reservation must precede the question for a trace to exist at all, since here the trace exists either way and only its recognition turns on when it was made.
items.why: Accurate to the business-records exception and its litigation-motive exclusion. It extends rather than restates witness-architectures' Arm's-length custody: there a perfect record in the accused's drawer witnesses nothing, here a record in the party's own drawer is admitted precisely because it was routine, so the two items are a genuine tension across the pair of maps. Keep.

items.item: Dissent before the gavel: a director present at a board's act is presumed to have assented unless her dissent is entered in the minutes or filed with the secretary before or immediately after adjournment, under the corporation statutes that carry the presumption, so the trace that later exempts her from liability must be made inside a window that closes with the meeting; the carrier is the minute book and the secretary's file; the rule is the presumption of assent from a silent presence, which reads the minutes and not her recollection; what ends the power is the adjournment, after which a memo written the next morning is a trace of a change of mind, so the director who argued hardest and let the vote pass in silence has the same record as the one who agreed; not a vote against, which is a position, since the mechanism is the record of the position and its deadline.
items.why: Accurate to the model act's presumption and its three escapes. The 'not a vote against' discriminator is slightly off, since a recorded vote against is the trace, but the item says so itself in the next clause. Keep.

items.item: Objection before the norm hardens: a state that objected openly and consistently to a rule while it was forming is not bound when the rule becomes customary law, so the exemption is carried by a trace of objection made during the years of formation and lost by a silence at any of them, since acquiescence is read from the gaps; the carrier is the diplomatic record, the reservation, the vote explained, the protest note; the rule is the persistent-objector doctrine, whose reading of consistency is contested and whose reach is narrower than states hope; what ends the power is a lapse in the objecting, or the rule hardening into one the doctrine grants no exemption from, and the last intervention that preserves it is a protest made at an occasion where saying nothing would have been easier; not Dissent before the gavel, a single window that closes with a meeting, since here the window is every occasion for years and the trace must be renewed at each; the case is treaties, and whether the same shape runs in trade custom and in 'market standard' contract terms is the map's speculative extension.
items.why: The doctrine is stated with its contestation visible, which is right. But 'the case is treaties' mislabels it: the persistent-objector doctrine belongs to customary international law, which binds a state that never signed unless it objected while the rule formed; a treaty is the opposite, binding only by consent, so silence toward a treaty binds nobody. Repaired in the final clause only; the speculative extension to contract custom is kept as marked.
items.repair: Objection before the norm hardens: a state that objected openly and consistently to a rule while it was forming is not bound when the rule becomes customary law, so the exemption is carried by a trace of objection made during the years of formation and lost by a silence at any of them, since acquiescence is read from the gaps; the carrier is the diplomatic record, the reservation, the vote explained, the protest note; the rule is the persistent-objector doctrine, whose reading of consistency is contested and whose reach is narrower than states hope; what ends the power is a lapse in the objecting, or the rule hardening into one the doctrine grants no exemption from, and the last intervention that preserves it is a protest made at an occasion where saying nothing would have been easier; not Dissent before the gavel, a single window that closes with a meeting, since here the window is every occasion for years and the trace must be renewed at each; the case is customary international law, where a state is bound by a rule it never signed unless it objected while the rule formed, which is the opposite of a treaty, where silence binds nobody; whether the same shape runs in trade custom and in 'market standard' contract terms is the map's speculative extension.

items.item: Postmark or doormat: an option is exercised by a trace, and whether the trace counts when dispatched or when it lands is settled by a rule the holder may not have read, as the tenant who mails her renewal notice on the last day, relying on the mailbox rule that governs ordinary acceptances, finds that the default for an option's exercise is receipt, so the notice that arrives two days later is late and the option is gone; the carrier is the notice with its proof of dispatch or of delivery; the rule is the contract's notice clause, or the default where the clause is silent; what ends the power is the option's expiry, which is precisely what the rule decides, so a holder can lose a valuable right by choosing the wrong mode of making the trace on the right day; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, a window in which a party may not seek, since here the window is one in which the party must arrive.
items.why: Correct on the default for option exercise against the general dispatch rule, and it passes the fence: the option is gone, not merely worse. Keep.

items.item: Bounty for the first to file: a trace held by several parties yields its power to whichever of them activates it first, as under the False Claims Act the first relator to file on a fraud bars every later one on the same facts, so the employee who keeps the memo and gathers more is racing colleagues she cannot see; the carrier is the copy outside the firm and the sealed complaint; the rule is the first-to-file bar together with the public-disclosure bar, which strips the power from every holder once the facts are public unless the filer is their original source; what ends the power is another holder's filing or a journalist's story, so the trace's value decays with every other hand that holds it and every day it stays unfiled; not Stamp beats sight, where the office's stamp creates a priority that did not exist, since here the trace already exists in many hands and the office only ranks the informants.
items.why: Passes the type and the discriminator against Stamp beats sight is exact. One modality softening noted: the first-to-file bar operates while the first action is pending, so a dismissed first filing hands the power back. No repair required for the shape.

items.item: Truck already rented: a promise with nothing given for it becomes enforceable through a trace the promisee makes by relying on it, as the candidate who resigned and signed a lease on the strength of a written offer that was then withdrawn recovers what the reliance cost her, so the trace that binds the promisor was made by the other party after the promise; the carrier is the reliance trace, the resignation letter, the lease, the mover's invoice; the rule is promissory estoppel, which reads the reliance as reasonable only if it followed the promise and preceded any retraction; what ends the power is a retraction that lands before the reliance, or reliance the promisor could not have foreseen, so the timing of the two traces against each other decides which party is bound and by how much; not who-can-be-bound, which names what of a party can be reached, since here the promisor was not reachable at all until the promisee made a trace of her own.
items.why: The classic reliance case is stated accurately. The trace here is evidence of conduct the rule reads directly, which is true of the three pen-swap items; the of-sentence's 'whose hand holds the pen' absorbs this, and my neighbor test shows the item separates from its hinge partner. Keep.

items.item: Rent taken after notice: the trace that empowers a party is made by the party it is used against, as a landlord who accepts rent after serving notice to quit has, in many jurisdictions, waived the notice, so the tenant's power to stay is carried by the landlord's own deposit record; the carrier is the bank's entry, made by the landlord's hand; the rule is waiver by conduct inconsistent with the election to end the tenancy, and the same rule lets a buyer who has accepted late deliveries for three years lose the right to reject the fourth; what ends the power is a reservation written into the acceptance, taken for use and occupancy only, or a fresh notice that restarts the clock the acceptance stopped, and the last intervention that preserves the landlord's power is the refusal of a payment he wanted; not power-trades' Silence on the tab, where the hold accumulates in what one party has withheld, since here a single act of taking creates a power in the hand of the one who paid.
items.why: Accurate as the common shape, with 'in many jurisdictions' kept visible. The course-of-dealing merge is the same mechanism. Keep.

items.item: Fence that ripens: open, continuous, and hostile occupation for the statutory period lets a trespasser take title, so the trace is the occupation itself, the fence, the crop, the taxes paid in the occupier's name, and the power it ripens into is against the owner's deed; the carrier is the land, the tax roll, and the years; the rule is the adverse-possession statute, whose requirement of hostility is the owner's opening; what ends the power is a letter of permission, since permitted use is not hostile and one such letter resets the period, or a suit brought inside it, so the last intervention that preserves the owner's title costs a stamp and most owners do not know it, and the occupier's power is ended most cheaply by a kindness on paper; not who-can-be-bound's Seizable title, where the registry makes land reachable, since here the land is taken from the registry by a trace the registry never saw.
items.why: Accurate. 'Most owners do not know it' is an author's observation stated as a frequency fact; harmless and noted under modality. The 'trace is the occupation itself' stretch is admitted in the text and is what lets the loop with Rent taken after notice be drawn. Keep.

items.item: Right without the paper: the power sits in a hand that does not hold the trace and may never see it, as an early note holder with a most-favored-nation clause is entitled to the better terms of any later note, which the company and the later investor hold and she does not, so her power depends on a notification duty written into the instrument and on the company honoring it; the carrier is the later instrument, in the hands of two parties who gain nothing by showing it; the rule is the clause together with the duty to notify, or an audit right, without which the power is real and blind; what ends the power is conversion in a priced round, which terminates the notes, or the later instrument being structured so that no comparable term exists, a side letter, a warrant, a different security; not term-sheet-powers' Claim on terms not yet written, which names the multiplier the clause becomes when a rescue must be propagated, since here the point is that the holder of the right and the holder of the trace are different people and the right is worth what the duty to notify is worth.
items.why: The map's new member and its best: the separation of the right's holder from the paper's holder is exactly what the first framing could not hold, and the distinction from term-sheet-powers' Claim on terms not yet written is real (multiplier there, notification duty here). Keep.

items.item: Gap that testifies: a trace the adversary failed to keep becomes the power of the party who can show the failure, as a court that finds records destroyed after a duty to preserve them attached may instruct the jury to assume they were unfavorable, so the absence is read as the worst version of what it would have said; the carrier is the retention schedule and the preservation letter, since the gap testifies only against the date on which the duty attached; the rule is the adverse-inference sanction, which reads the timing of the destruction against the timing of the duty; what ends the power is proof that the destruction ran on the routine schedule before the duty attached, or a duplicate found elsewhere that fills the gap; not witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt, an arrangement that makes the accused build the instrument, since here nothing was built and the power comes from a gap the other side can date.
items.why: The mechanism omits the element that is actually contested in every spoliation fight: culpability. For electronic records the federal rule since 2015 grants the adverse-inference instruction only on a finding of intent to deprive; negligent failure to stop a routine schedule earns curative measures, not the presumption. As written, the item hands the power to anyone who can show destruction after the duty attached, which is the pre-2015 minority position promoted to the common shape. It extends rather than restates witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt, since that item is an ex ante arrangement and this is an ex post power dated by a letter. Repaired to carry the culpability element and its effect on the endings.
items.repair: Gap that testifies: a trace the adversary failed to keep becomes the power of the party who can show the failure, as a court that finds records destroyed after a duty to preserve them attached, and destroyed with the culpability its rule demands, may instruct the jury to assume they were unfavorable, so the absence is read as the worst version of what it would have said; the carrier is the retention schedule and the preservation letter, since the gap testifies only against the date on which the duty attached; the rule is the adverse-inference sanction, which reads the timing of the destruction against the timing of the duty and, for electronic records under the federal rule, grants the presumption only on a finding that the loss was meant to deprive; what ends the power is proof that the destruction ran on the routine schedule before the duty attached, a duplicate found elsewhere that fills the gap, or a showing that the schedule was carelessly left running rather than aimed, which leaves the other side a lesser remedy and not the inference; not witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt, an arrangement that makes the accused build the instrument, since here nothing was built and the power comes from a gap the other side can date.

items.item: Held unfired: the trace's power is a standing threat that its activation destroys, as a compromising record is worth the whole of what its subject will do to keep it unseen and nothing the day after it is seen, so the holder's power is greatest while the trace is credible and unused and is spent by the one act it licenses; the carrier is the copy and the subject's belief that it exists and would be believed; the rule is the subject's dependence on a third party's not knowing; what ends the power is disclosure by anyone, including the subject, who can spend the holder's trace by making one of her own, the confession that precedes the reveal, and a switch that releases the copy on the holder's death is the same trace with a different ending, since it survives the party it is meant to protect; described as a mechanism and not as a practice; not ghost-leverages' blackmail file on conduct nobody would now condemn, where the trace has lost its reader, since here the reader exists and the trace is spent by reaching him.
items.why: Admitted at the one point on the itinerary where activation and ending are one act, and the fence against advantages-spent-by-use is written into the limits. The 'described as a mechanism and not as a practice' marker is the right modality. Keep.

items.item: Stale paper: the trace's power expires on a calendar that has nothing to do with the truth it records, as a bill of lading presented to the bank more than twenty-one days after shipment is refused under the uniform customs for documentary credits whatever the goods and however genuine the bill, and as a timestamped photograph of the odometer defeats a rental damage charge only inside the card network's dispute window, after which it proves the same thing to nobody who will act; the carrier is the credit or the dispute procedure and its checker; the rule is a reader that examines documents and dates and never goods, which makes the trace's age the whole of its recognition; what ends the power is the twenty-first day, or the window's close, whichever the reader counts first; not Bearer's cargo, where the paper's power lasts as long as the cargo does, since here a paper that could still claim the goods can no longer claim the money.
items.why: The twenty-one-day rule and the documents-not-goods principle are accurate. But the item names the reader as the carrier, against the of-sentence's 'carrier that holds the trace': the credit's checker holds nothing, the bill with its shipment date does. Repaired in that clause only.
items.repair: Stale paper: the trace's power expires on a calendar that has nothing to do with the truth it records, as a bill of lading presented to the bank more than twenty-one days after shipment is refused under the uniform customs for documentary credits whatever the goods and however genuine the bill, and as a timestamped photograph of the odometer defeats a rental damage charge only inside the card network's dispute window, after which it proves the same thing to nobody who will act; the carrier is the bill with its shipment date and the photograph with its timestamp, read by the credit's document checker or the network's dispute procedure; the rule is a reader that examines documents and dates and never goods, which makes the trace's age the whole of its recognition; what ends the power is the twenty-first day, or the window's close, whichever the reader counts first; not Bearer's cargo, where the paper's power lasts as long as the cargo does, since here a paper that could still claim the goods can no longer claim the money.

items.item: Key that lights its own fuse: the trace that gives a claimant her standing is the trace that starts the clock on her claim, as the discovery rule runs the limitations period from when the plaintiff knew or should have known of the injury, so the diagnosis note or the message in which she shows she understood is at once her proof and the date from which her right decays; the carrier is the record of the claimant's own knowledge, which the defendant's first request is for; the rule is the discovery rule together with the limitations period; what ends the power is the period run from the trace's own date, so the party who documents her injury most carefully fixes her deadline most exactly, and the undocumented claimant has a vaguer key and a later fuse; not Stale paper, where the expiry is set by a calendar indifferent to the trace, since here the trace is the calendar's origin.
items.why: Accurate to the discovery rule, and 'a later fuse' for the undocumented claimant is defensible in expectation, since a record of actual knowledge can only fix accrual at or before the constructive-knowledge date. Keep.

neighbor_test.left: Truck already rented: a promise with nothing given for it becomes enforceable through a trace the promisee makes by relying on it, as the candidate who resigned and signed a lease on the strength of a written offer that was then withdrawn recovers what the reliance cost her, so the trace that binds the promisor was made by the other party after the promise; the carrier is the reliance trace, the resignation letter, the lease, the mover's invoice; the rule is promissory estoppel, which reads the reliance as reasonable only if it followed the promise and preceded any retraction; what ends the power is a retraction that lands before the reliance, or reliance the promisor could not have foreseen, so the timing of the two traces against each other decides which party is bound and by how much; not who-can-be-bound, which names what of a party can be reached, since here the promisor was not reachable at all until the promisee made a trace of her own.
neighbor_test.right: Rent taken after notice: the trace that empowers a party is made by the party it is used against, as a landlord who accepts rent after serving notice to quit has, in many jurisdictions, waived the notice, so the tenant's power to stay is carried by the landlord's own deposit record; the carrier is the bank's entry, made by the landlord's hand; the rule is waiver by conduct inconsistent with the election to end the tenancy, and the same rule lets a buyer who has accepted late deliveries for three years lose the right to reject the fourth; what ends the power is a reservation written into the acceptance, taken for use and occupancy only, or a fresh notice that restarts the clock the acceptance stopped, and the last intervention that preserves the landlord's power is the refusal of a payment he wanted; not power-trades' Silence on the tab, where the hold accumulates in what one party has withheld, since here a single act of taking creates a power in the hand of the one who paid.
neighbor_test.separating_case: The author calls these the hinge and says they share one rule shape, a later act read against an earlier election, with the pen in opposite hands. Test whether the pen is the only difference. A landlord serves notice to quit and then accepts a month's rent from a tenant who is already packing and has relied on nothing: waiver stands in the many jurisdictions that read acceptance as inconsistent with the election, and the tenant may stay, with no reliance anywhere in the case. Conversely, a landlord serves notice, promises orally that the tenant may renew, and the tenant turns down another flat on the strength of it, but no rent is ever taken: promissory estoppel may bind the landlord, and no act of his after the election exists for waiver to read. Waiver needs no reliance by the empowered party; estoppel needs no act by the bound party after the promise. The two mechanisms read different acts, not the same act from different hands, so the hinge is a real joint and not one item written twice.

boundary_case: A source-code escrow: the vendor deposits the code with an agent and the licensee receives it on the vendor's bankruptcy, so a specified party takes an action otherwise unavailable, the deposit has a carrier and release conditions, and the vendor's cure ends the power. It looks like Held unfired's switch with the ending reversed. It is out. The deposit is not a trace of anything; it is the capability itself, a stored means like a spare key with the neighbor. Every admitted item's trace records a fact that stands without it (goods received, an order signed, a fraud, a payment taken, an occupation) and the rule reads the record. The ruling sharpens the fence: in if the trace is a record of a fact and the rule makes the action unavailable without it, out if the held thing is the means of the action rather than a witness of a fact.

seriation.note: The axis holds and the endpoints teach: possession as the whole power at one end, a trace that dates its own death at the other. One stop is misfiled and it sits on the author's hinge. Squawk that grounds is placed at the possession stop ('traces that must be in the room or written by the one who refuses'), but its own text says the moment of activation is the moment of making, which is the activation stop, and its pen is the empowered party's own. It belongs immediately before Truck already rented, giving the run Squawk (my pen makes the power at once) → Truck (my pen, read against your promise) → Rent (your pen, read against your election), which makes the pen swap a three-step passage rather than a two-item hinge. The closing run Held unfired → Stale paper → Key that lights its own fuse is the map's best adjacency and should be kept as written. The form inference should claim one incompatibility (Held unfired → Bounty, which is real and stronger than labeled) and reclassify Made before it mattered → Key as a tradeoff the map cannot resolve without the period's length, which is what the label itself already says.

edges.why: The antecedent can fail (documents presented inside the twenty-one days) and the consequent is a real fork: the issuing bank may seek the applicant's waiver of the discrepancy, and the holder of the original still commands the goods at discharge. The fork is exactly what a sequence conceals.

edges.to_handle: Key that lights its own fuse
edges.why: The label makes the defendant's use of the claimant's record depend on the business-records rule, but a party's own statement is admissible against her as an admission whatever its regularity. So the record dates her fuse whether or not it was routine, and only a routine record gives her the key. The asymmetry is the sharper claim, and it turns the relation from the claimed incompatibility into a tradeoff.
edges.repair_label: If the injured party's own record of her injury exists at all, the defendant can use it against her to fix the day her limitations clock started, since a party's own statement is admissible against her whatever its regularity, while the same record serves as her proof only if it was kept in a routine the business-records rule trusts; so the note first written when the lawyer arrives dates her fuse without giving her a key, the routine record gives her the key at the price of the same fuse, and only the claimant who wrote nothing keeps a fuse whose date must be argued from other hands, and the map cannot say which she should prefer without knowing how long the period is.

edges.why: The dependency is real: the routine that admits her records fixes the date after which their absence speaks, and the letter moves that date. But 'destruction on that same schedule one cycle after the preservation letter arrived is a confession' overstates the sanction. Under the federal rule for electronic records, a schedule carelessly left running after the letter earns curative measures; the presumption of the worst requires a finding that the loss was meant to deprive.
edges.repair_label: If the records a party kept in the ordinary course are the ones the rule would admit for her, the same ordinary course decides when their absence speaks against her: destruction on the routine schedule before the duty attached is silence, destruction on that same schedule after the preservation letter arrived is a sanctionable failure, and it becomes the presumption of the worst only where the court finds the schedule was left running on purpose; so the routine that makes her records usable by her fixes the date after which their disappearance is usable by the other side, the letter is the trace that moves that date, and what the other side gets past that date depends on why the schedule was not stopped.

edges.why: The antecedent can fail (the owner writes permission and takes nothing) and the consequent is accurate: a payment taken for use makes the possession permissive, which ends hostility and opens a tenancy in which acceptance after notice waives the notice. The forward half of the loop is sound.

The return is drawn correctly but its modality is inverted. That a tenant's possession turns adverse only from a clear disclaimer brought home to the landlord is settled doctrine, not the map's most speculative claim; the speculation is behavioral, an owner whose lesson from the first waiver is inaction. The label should mark which part is which, and it should state the knowledge requirement, since a repudiation the owner never learns of starts no clock.
edges.repair_label: If the occupier, once her notice is waived, stops paying altogether and repudiates the tenancy in a way brought home to the owner, and the owner, having learned not to take rent, takes nothing and does nothing, the possession that began as a tenancy becomes hostile from that repudiation and the ripening clock starts there; the law of the return is settled, since a tenant's possession turns adverse only from a disclaimer the landlord knows of, and the speculation, which the map marks as its most speculative edge, is the owner whose lesson from the first waiver is inaction rather than a fresh notice or a suit.

edges.to_handle: Bounty for the first to file
edges.why: The incompatibility is real and the antecedent can fail (she files). But 'either event also ends her lever' is wrong for the first event: a qui tam complaint is filed under seal, so a colleague's filing takes the bounty on the day it lands and tells the employer nothing, and the lever goes on working over a trace whose bounty is already gone. That is the stronger claim and the label should carry it.
edges.repair_label: If the employee who holds the memo uses it as a private lever over her employer rather than filing it, she has started a clock she cannot read: a colleague's sealed filing takes the bounty from her on the day it is filed and tells nobody, so her lever goes on working over a trace whose bounty is already gone, while a reporter's story strips the bounty from everyone and ends the lever in the same hour; so the unfired trace is worth most at exactly the moment its other holders are likeliest to fire it, holding and filing cannot both be chosen for long, and the holder who chooses holding may not learn for years which one she lost.

edges.why: A genuine passage between scales: the antecedent (a single-meeting window versus a years-long formation) is a real fork in the rule, and the consequent that one lapse forfeits the state's exemption while the director's single timely dissent holds is what the persistent-objector doctrine's consistency requirement means. Keep.

modality_problems: Gap that testifies states the adverse-inference instruction as available on a finding of destruction after the duty attached; the culpability element that every spoliation fight turns on is missing, and for electronic records the federal rule grants the presumption only on intent to deprive. Repaired.
Objection before the norm hardens says 'the case is treaties'; the doctrine belongs to customary international law, and a treaty is the consent-based opposite. Repaired.

Squawk that grounds says a failing check blocks a merge 'that a manager cannot force'; administrators can bypass branch protection, so the honest claim is that forcing it takes the admin key and leaves an entry. Repaired.
Stale paper names the reader (the credit, the dispute procedure and its checker) as the carrier, against the of-sentence's carrier that holds the trace. Repaired.

The return edge Rent taken after notice → Fence that ripens is marked as the map's most speculative, but the legal return (adverse possession runs from a disclaimer brought home to the landlord) is settled; only the owner's inaction is speculative. Repaired in the label.

Bearer's cargo says that under a straight bill 'possession proves nothing'; that is the United States shape, and English law still requires presentation of a straight bill. The item states the common shape under the map's limits and no repair is required, but the clause is jurisdiction-bound.

Bounty for the first to file says the first filing 'bars every later one on the same facts'; the bar operates while the first action is pending, and a dismissed first action hands the power back. Shape unaffected; no repair.
Fence that ripens says 'most owners do not know it', an author's observation stated as a frequency fact; a two-word touch would make it visible and no repair is required.
Held unfired is correctly held at mechanism-not-practice, and the sibling map advantages-spent-by-use is fenced in the limits; no problem.
best_unresolved_seed: The trace made by the bound party into the empowered party's hand, with the date left blank: the undated signed resignation letter a board holds over a director, the blank-endorsed stock power a lender holds under a pledge, the pre-signed confession or admission kept in a drawer. It combines Rent taken after notice's pen (the bound party wrote it), Bearer's cargo's possession (the empowered party holds it), and Postmark or doormat's activation (the holder chooses the moment and writes the date), so it is the one stop on the itinerary where all three steps sit in the hands the map says cannot coincide, and its ending is the rule that refuses a date added by another hand. Whether courts read such a trace as the signer's act or the holder's, and where the line falls, is a map of its own.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the recording-act item, whose 'order of entries' was the race statute's shape alone and whose endings belonged to two different parties, correcting the treaty mislabel in the persistent-objector item, adding the culpability element to the spoliation item, fixing two carrier and overclaim clauses, relabeling three edges (the plaintiff's own record dates her fuse as an admission whatever its regularity, a sealed filing kills the bounty without ending the lever, and the tenant-to-hostile return is doctrine with only the owner's inaction speculative), and moving Squawk that grounds to the activation stop before the pen-swap hinge.
